description: Retrospective permission for erection of a single storey rear extension.
decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - The single storey rear extension forms an unsympathetic and disproportionate addition that fails to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the host dwelling, the terrace of which it forms part, and the wider surrounding area. 
The development therefore fails to comply with Policy LP1, and Policy LP5 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023), and the guidance within the Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 2 - By reason of its excessive mass, scale and design, the development results in a material loss of light and outlook to the adjoining residential properties. It has an unduly overbearing impact, creating a heightened sense of enclosure and visual intrusion along both shared boundaries, to the detriment of neighbouring amenity and the enjoyment of their rear gardens and internal living spaces.
The development therefore fails to comply with Policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023), and the guidance within the Housing SPD (2016).
Reason : 3 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
